decisions.reason: As a large, established German electrical equipment firm we would keep this niche marine lighting offer for now, but its weaker website prominence suggests results may be below aspiration and therefore it carries a moderate risk of being culled if follow-on demand stays thin.

A dedicated product page and the product’s close technological fit with professional lighting make it likely to stay, with our organisational slack allowing more time to learn whether medical-market sales reach aspiration levels.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit our core industrial engineering capabilities well, and in a large mature firm this kind of specialised B2B product would normally be retained unless performance clearly fell short of aspiration.
Because this is presented as a relaunch of a popular designer task light, its prior acceptance raises aspiration confidence and makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
